standard-dialogue.npc: You look like somebody who could use a bit of armour. What do you say?

steps.npc: Maybe I overestimated you. I suppose such fine equipment isn't for everyone.

right-click-repair-option.text: If the player has nothing to repair in their inventory:

steps.npc: You don't have anything I can repair.

right-click-repair-option.text: If the player has something that can be repaired in their inventory:

options.text: Repair that item: [cost to repair single item] coins.

steps.npc: There you go, happy doing business with you!

options.text: Repair all items: [cost to repair all items] coins.
options.condition: If the player has more than one thing that can be repaired in their inventory:

steps.npc: There you go, happy doing business with you!

using-an-item-on-aneirin.npc: Sorry friend, but I can't do anything with that.
